turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You have been good to me, I know, but now you must see to our son's marriage.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not speak of this now, my love, you are not well.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will do as you say, I will find a good wife for myself.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You are young and foolish, but I know you will do well.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother, I will help with the arrangements.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You are very kind, but I must see to this myself.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You must not exhaust yourself, my love.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am not exhausted, I am only tired of being sick.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Father, I will go to the market and find a good wife for myself.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Be careful, my son, and do not bring home anyone who is not good.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will go and prepare the rooms for the guests.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You are very busy, but I am glad you can help.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will take care of everything, my love.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You are kind, but I must see to this myself.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will go and find a good wife for myself.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Be careful, my son, and do not bring home anyone who is not good.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will go and prepare the food for the guests.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You are very kind, but I am glad you can help.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will take care of everything, my love.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you will, but I must see to this myself.

opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
